scope_summary: Design, installation, operation, maintenance and use of structural monitoring systems, including uncertainty and decision use.
overlap: SAMCO, Sustainable Bridges, ISHMS and TRB E-C246 cover much methodology, but UNI/TR is directly referenced by the Italian bridge guideline and consolidates an operational monitoring lifecycle.
rationale: Highest-priority technical monitoring purchase. Purchase the 2026 edition, not 2016, because the project uses Linee Guida Ponti and must make the monitoring architecture auditable.
